  Burbank Cultural Arts Commission Meeting Minutes

  Thursday, September 10, 2026
CALL TO ORDER
The meeting was called to order at 9:01 am by Chair Leah Harrison.

ROLL CALL
Present  Monica Pa Moye (left at 10:42 a.m.), Leah Harrison, Eric Conner (left at 11:02 a.m.), Mercedes Cooper,
  James Fletcher, Stefanie Girard, Cynthia Pease, Katherine Zoraster

Absent:  None

Staff Present:  Kristen Smith, Erin Barrows, Christie Lesinski, Bryce Burton, Andrea Del Rio, Christina Romero

Liaisons Present: Tamala Takahashi

ANNOUNCEMENTS
Ms. Barrows announced the Commission’s new Recording Secretary. She thanked Mr. Burton for his time and
contributions to the Commission. Ms. Barrows also thanked everyone for a successful Starlight Bowl season and shared
information regarding the vacant Commission seat and the upcoming Boards and Commissions Recognition at Burbank
Water and Power on October 20.

Mr. Burton provided an update on the current exhibit and an upcoming photography exhibit at the Betsy Lueke Creative
Arts Center. He also announced an upcoming Movie Night at Johnny Carson Park on October 10.

Mr. Conner announced upcoming art-related events taking place in Burbank during the month of September.

Ms. Girard provided information on the Pumpkin Patch & Artisan Market event.

Ms. Pease encouraged the Commissioners to attend the Flourish Art Gallery.

ORAL COMMUNICATION
Tom Pease announced an upcoming Musona Chamber Choir fall performance and provided information on the program.

Brad Bucklin, representing Burbank Bla Bla Magazine, announced the upcoming 17th issue and invited submissions for
current and future editions. He also announced the launch of an online art gallery.

Ernesto Cinzano, a mural artist, presented his mural canvas to the Commission and shared that he aims to beautify the
City through murals.

Eric Haack, Burbank Community Band, announced the band’s upcoming performances, including the annual Halloween
Concert. He also encouraged wind and percussion musicians to join the band.

Mike Stanley, Conductor of the Burbank Community Band, encouraged the community to attend the Burbank
Community Band Halloween Concert and announced the launch of an educational initiative for the 2026-27 year.

Tamala Takahashi, Mayor of Burbank, provided announcements from the City Council and thanked the Commission for
its work.

Corey Mensing, from the Heritage Commission, introduced himself, expressed interest in collaborating with the
Commission, and encouraged members to attend an upcoming Heritage Commission meeting. He also presented a
coloring book created by the Heritage Commission.
 REPSONSE TO ORAL COMMUNICATIONS  FINAL
Ms. Pease encouraged Commissioners to participate in art events and noted the potential economic benefits to the
City.

Ms. Cooper inquired about the process for petitioning for a mural and suggested murals as potential candidates for
the utility box project. She also expressed interest in collaborating with Mr. Mensing regarding his coloring book
presentation.

Ms. Pa Moye thanked Mr. Mensing for attending the meeting and emphasized the importance of Commissioners
attending other commission meetings to foster partnerships and collaboration.

Ms. Harrison thanked Mr. Pease and encouraged members to attend the performance. She also encouraged members
to contact Mr. Bucklin to be featured in his publications. Ms. Harrison thanked Mr. Haack and Mr. Stanley and
acknowledged the Burbank Community Band. She also noted Mr. Mensing’s interest in collaborating with the Heritage
Commission. Ms. Harrison concluded by thanking Ms. Takahashi for sharing positive news regarding the City.

WRITTEN COMMUNICATIONS
None.

CONSENT AGENDA
APPROVAL OF MINUTES AND FINANCIAL UPDATE for August 13, 2026 - Regular Meeting Action: A motion was made by
Ms. Pease seconded by Ms. Pa Maye and passed 7-0 to approve August Consent Calendar. (In favor: Monica Pa Moye,
Leah Harrison, Eric Conner, Mercedes Cooper, James Fletcher, Stefanie Girard, Cynthia Pease – Abstain: Katherine
Zoraster).

NEW BUSINESS

  1. Community Arts Grant Program Update
  Ms. Lesinski provided the Commission with an update on the Community Arts Grant Program. She reported
  that the fourth grant cycle is currently open and provided information on upcoming workshop dates
  scheduled for September 16 and September 30. The application deadline for the current cycle is October 16,
  with grantees to be announced in January. Ms. Lesinski also provided general information regarding artist
  eligibility requirements.

  Community Arts Grant recipients provided updates on their upcoming events and projects supported through
  the Community Arts Grant Program. Sara Logsdon and Bryan Snodgrass of Conundrum Theater Company
  highlighted the upcoming New Works Festival. Katelyn Dietz and Rhiannon Lewis of C3LA (Contemporary
  Choral Collective of Los Angeles) presented information regarding an upcoming concert scheduled for
  October 24 featuring new short films accompanied by live performances from their in-house composers.
  Rebecca Newcomer of the Salit Foundation presented information on an upcoming concert, Peter and the
  Wolf, scheduled for October at the Burbank Public Library. Sarah Robinson of Helix Collective announced the
  upcoming concert Public Broadcast Stereo, scheduled for October 25, and thanked the Commission for its
  support.

  Ms. Harrison thanked each of the grantees. Ms. Cooper also acknowledged the grantees and expressed
  appreciation for their responsiveness to community needs. Ms. Pa Moye encouraged the grantees to present
  to other City commissions and encouraged fellow Commissioners to attend the grantees’ upcoming
  performances. Ms. Pease recommended that the grantees bring flyers to the upcoming Autumn Arts Festival
  at Johnny Carson Park. Mr. Conner also encouraged the grantees to present to City Council and other groups
  to further promote their work.
   FINAL
  2. Art Block- Holiday in the Park
  Jeff Ferguson of Magnolia Park announced an Art Block at Holiday in the Park and requested the
  Commission’s assistance. Applications are currently open, and Mr. Ferguson asked the Commission to share
  the call for artists with local artists. Mr. Ferguson also requested that a Commission representative
  participate as a juror in reviewing applications and selecting an artist. Mr. Fletcher and Ms. Zoraster
  volunteered to serve as judges on the panel. Mr. Ferguson provided information regarding volunteer
  opportunities and requested a volunteer to serve as the onsite Art Block coordinator. He also shared that
  they are looking for additional sponsorships. The application deadline for Art Block submissions is October 8.
  Ms. Lesinski suggested that promotion through the City newsletter and social media could help encourage
  additional artist applications.

  3. Autumn Arts Festival
  Ms. Lesinski provided an update on the Autumn Arts Festival, including the final band lineup and participating
  grantees who have committed to hosting booths, with hopes of additional participants. She also provided
  information regarding the Burbank Cultural Arts Commission booth and requested that Commissioners sign
  up for shifts during the event. Ms. Lesinski shared that the sticker series featuring artwork from the utility box
  art program will be available at the Commission booth. Ms. Barrows encouraged Commissioners to
  participate in the event. She also requested an additional $3,000 for the Autumn Arts Festival, which the
  Commission approved.

  Regular Meeting Action: A motion was made by Mr. Fletcher seconded by Ms. Zoraster and passed 7-0 to
  approve an additional $3,000 in funding for the event (In favor: Leah Harrison, Eric Conner, Mercedes
  Cooper, James Fletcher, Stefanie Girard, Cynthia Pease, Katherine Zoraster – Absent: Monica Pa Moye (left at
  10:42 a.m.).

  4. Beautification Update
  Ms. Lesinski provided an update on Phase 10 of the utility box beautification program and presented a map
  of Phase 10 identifying the locations of each utility box. Ms. Lesinski announced that they are seeking
  sponsorships for the utility boxes.

  Ms. Zoroaster volunteered to join the Sponsorship Ad Hoc Committee, joining Ms. Pease, Mr. Conner, and
  Ms. Pa Moye.

OLD BUSINESS

GOALS

  Goal 1: Capacity
  Ms. Pa Moye provided an update on the subcommittee’s discussion regarding the grant process and potential
  improvements to the program. The subcommittee is also exploring additional grant opportunities, including a
  film grant and the possibility of a micro-grant program.

  Ms. Pa Moye discussed the goal of building partnerships with organizations and businesses throughout the
  City. Ms. Pa Moye and Ms. Lesinski will be meeting with a Disney representative to discuss potential
  partnerships, with the goal of continuing similar discussions with other major companies in the City.

  Ms. Barrows announced that the Art Grants Ad Hoc Committee was established through the Capacity
  Subcommittee and, due to the vacant position, Ms. Cooper volunteered to join the committee. Ms. Lesinski
  also shared that panelists will be needed for the Community Arts Grant Program, which will be discussed at
  the next meeting.
   FINAL

  Goal 2: Visibility
  Mr. Conner announced that the subcommittee discussed bringing in a marketing professional to provide
  training and workshops to assist with the Commission’s social media efforts. The possibility of opening the
  educational workshop to other entities in the City and the Parks and Recreation Department was also
  discussed. Mr. Conner also announced that the team discussed hosting a pop-up event. Mr. Burton
  recommended the Betsy Lueke Creative Arts Center as a potential site for a pop-up event.

  Goal 3: Spaces
  Ms. Zoraster announced a merged spaces list that will be posted on the website. Ms. Zoraster announced that
  she spoke with someone from the Burbank Chamber of Commerce and hopes to schedule a meeting to
  collaborate. Ms. Zoraster also announced that she and Mr. Fletcher will be visiting a local gallery, The Black
  Sheep.

  Goal 4: Advocacy
  Ms. Pease shared that the subcommittee discussed at its most recent meeting the possibility of holding mixers
  with different themes and inviting local businesses. She recommended revisiting the idea at a later time. Ms.
  Zoraster joined the Advocacy Subcommittee. Ms. Barrows encouraged the Commission to attend City Council
  meetings and other board meetings.

NEW AGENDA ITEMS
Ms. Barrows announced that a Site-Specific Plan, including grantees, is scheduled for October.

Ms. Harrison requested that the subcommittees have a set of goals ready by the next couple of meetings.

ADJOURNMENT
The meeting was adjourned at 11:03 a.m. by Chair Ms. Harrison.
